basic.name: Healing Dart
basic.description: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195~~0.04~~ Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

basic.name: Biotic Grenade
basic.description:
Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152~~0.04~~ Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60~~0.04~~ damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds.

If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

basic.name: Sleep Dart
basic.description:
Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds.

Cannot be used on Vehicles.

basic.name: High Powered Round
basic.description: Fire a specialized round with unlimited range, piercing all allied and enemy Heroes in its path. Allies are healed for 225~~0.04~~ and enemies are damaged for 135~~0.04~~. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

heroic.name: Nano Boost
heroic.description:
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.

Cannot be used on Ana.

heroic.name: Eye of Horus
heroic.description:
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225~~0.04~~ and enemies are damaged for 135~~0.04~~. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

heroic.name: High Powered Round
heroic.description: Fire a specialized round with unlimited range, piercing all allied and enemy Heroes in its path. Allies are healed for 225~~0.04~~ and enemies are damaged for 135~~0.04~~. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

trait.name: Shrike
trait.description:
Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40~~0.04~~ damage over 5 seconds, plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike.

Aim Down Sights

Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.

activable.name: Debilitating Dart
activable.description: Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

activable.name: Active Reload
activable.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

level1.name: Contact Healing
level1.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.

level1.name: Slumber Shells
level1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level1.name: Vampiric Rounds
level1.description:
Increase Shrike's healing by 15%.

Repeatable Quest: Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%.

Repeatable Quest: Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%.

level4.name: Biotic Enhancements
level4.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level4.name: Overdose
level4.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses. While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

level4.name: Debilitating Dart
level4.description: Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

level7.name: Anti-Healer
level7.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

level7.name: Night Terrors
level7.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

level7.name: Mind-Numbing Agent
level7.description: Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.

level13.name: Speed Serum
level13.description: Healing Dart grants 25% Movement Speed to affected Heroes for 2 seconds.

level13.name: Purifying Darts
level13.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

level13.name: Smelling Salts
level13.description: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

level16.name: Sharpshooter
level16.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

level16.name: Concentrated Doses
level16.description: Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.

level16.name: Active Reload
level16.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

level20.name: Nano Infusion
level20.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

level20.name: Deadeye
level20.description:
Eye of Horus cooldown reduced to 6 seconds, but it only regains new rounds every 10 seconds. Remaining cooldown is converted to rounds.

For every Hero Eye of Horus hits, increases its damage and healing by 5%. This bonus resets after leaving Eye of Horus or after 4 seconds.

level20.name: Armored Stance
level20.description: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.

level20.name: Dynamic Optics
level20.description: Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.
